decisions.reason: Locates the exact disabled expression, establishes busy has no binding in AttachmentChips (it is AttachButton's useState cell), and explains both gates: empty occurrences return null before the map; a present occurrence in plain phase makes the left operand false, evaluating busy and raising ReferenceError.

Explains the render-body throw is caught by the slot-level error boundary which unmounts the whole entry (not just the remove button), that the attach button is a separate entry with its own boundary, and that the boundary's capture is console-only with no user-facing banner.

Uses the shipped v0.2.10 file's || busy to show the token predates the diff, proposes a baseline render mount of the pre-v0.2.11 file plus token/feature revert isolation, flags the diff/baseline inconsistency and the unbound status/record imageItem line, and explicitly declines to claim when v0.2.10 users first exercised the failure.

Removes || busy while preserving the phase guard (hoisted locked), offers an explicitly-owned-state alternative, hardens with (record?.items ?? []), optional-chains the event target, and moves the imageItem lookup inside the callback where record/status are defined.

Provides a data-present plain-phase mount test asserting zero boundary captures and the chip/remove DOM, explains the empty state returns null before the throwing line and that node --check only parses without binding resolution or execution, and includes a per-slot data-present render smoke in the pre-ship gate.
